title: Blue Dragon Sorceress
description: A woman with elaborate white-blonde updo stands on a rocky outcrop in a shiny blue jumpsuit and red heels, holding a smoking cigarette holder. Behind her a large blue dragon coils around a fairy-tale castle atop a mountain under a dark swirling sky, with a colorful reflective river flowing in the foreground containing a black silhouette shadow.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene featuring a confident woman with an enormous white-blonde curly updo and pink ribbon standing on a dark rock in a shiny blue jumpsuit, black gloves, and red heels, holding a long cigarette holder with smoke. She stands in the foreground of a swirling dark sky with golden spirals. A large blue Chinese-style dragon coils around a fairy tale castle with blue spires on a rocky mountain. A colorful swirling river flows through the scene containing a large black silhouette shadow of a witch on a broom, in a rich painterly style with dramatic lighting.
